Nx Build "s1ngularity" Supply Chain Attack

Target: nx-build
Repository: https://github.com/nrwl/nx
Date: 2025-08-26 to 2025-08-27 (1 day)
Attribution: Third Party
Component: Build Tool
Language: JavaScript
Cause: CI/CD Exploit
Motive: Credential Theft/Data Exfiltration
Transitive: false
Impact Type: Data Exfiltration/Disruption
User Impact: 0
Domain: npmjs.com (package host)
Artifact Type: source archive
Insertion Phase: distribution

Synopsis

Attackers exploited a vulnerable GitHub Action workflow in the Nx build platform repository to modify publish.yml and extract a maintainer's npm token. Using this token, they published 19 malicious versions of Nx packages containing a post-installation script (telemetry.js) that targeted macOS and Linux. The malware searched for crypto wallets, GitHub/npm tokens, and SSH keys, exfiltrating the data to public GitHub repositories (e.g., s1ngularity-repository) created under the victim's account, and then forced system shutdowns.

Compromised Versions

  • 20.9.0
  • 20.10.0
  • 20.11.0
  • 20.12.0
  • 21.5.0
  • 21.6.0
  • 21.7.0
  • 21.8.0
  • 3.2.0
